parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with schizophrenia indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where max_phase_for_ind equals 4 and mesh_heading equals schizophrenia. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
